title: Configuration Sensitivity of LLM-Based Synthetic Tabular Data Generators
summary: An empirical study measuring how task-irrelevant serialization/formatting choices affect the fidelity, utility, and generator rankings of LLM-based synthetic tabular data generators (GReaT, in-context learning) across three benchmark datasets. SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer are run as config-invariant, non-LLM control generators that establish a seed-only variance noise floor against which LLM configuration sensitivity is measured.
